# Semantic Comment Analysis

> Deterministic sentiment classification and explainable token attribution for production NLP pipelines.

- [Platform Overview](/): Local CPU-native dense embedding triage and LOO occlusion showcase.

- [Batch Processing](/): Chunked streaming CSV inference pipeline.
- [Architecture & Specs](/): Decoupled FastAPI ASGI ingestion and sentence transformer pipeline.
- [API Reference](/): REST endpoints and JSON schemas for production integration.
